Hi Lydia / team —

Appreciate the artifacts — helpful context. A few notes from the infra side after a quick review of the diagram you sent: 

- VPC options: We can support a managed Private deployment where we deploy Redwood’s runtime into a customer-controlled VPC (VPC peering or PrivateLink-style). That keeps control of network egress and routing with FinHealth.
- On-prem/air-gapped: For stricter requirements we offer an air-gapped installer bundle (requires on-site infra and initial support window). The air-gapped option includes local image registry and offline model bundles; we’ll need a list of allowed outbound endpoints (for license verification and package updates) or we can provide a manual update process.
- Encryption & keys: KMS integration (customer-managed) supported for at-rest keys and HSM options for higher assurance.
- Logging & audit: We can stream audit logs to your SIEM via secure forwarders (TLS) or push to an S3-compatible endpoint in your control.

I’m attaching a slightly more detailed Private deployment diagram and a checklist of items we typically need from infra for the PoC. 

Would you be able to confirm the expected number of inference nodes and peak QPS so we can size the deployment for the PoC? Even a rough number helps (e.g., 4–8 GPUs).

Thanks — happy to walk through these in the technical deep-dive.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai
